label: D1 after a rare a1->S2 transition (earlier in the episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), almost exclusively when the previous trial was a1 followed by a rare transition to S2 (prev_action==1 & prev_common==0 covers ~86% of activation mass; prev a2 rare (a2->S1) gives essentially zero activity, and prev common gives 5 of 17k activations). The remaining ~14% of mass sits at the window first D1 (rel -3), where the previous trial lies outside the window, so it is probably the same pattern. Activity fades over the episode and is absent after trial ~80, so ep_trial<70 raises precision from 0.37 to 0.51 (dev F1 0.52 -> 0.62). It fires after both rewarded and unrewarded rare trials; rewarded rare trials give higher precision (0.62 vs 0.46) and somewhat larger magnitude. Activations coincide with a positive (a1-leaning) policy logit and mid-range value. Precision stays at about 0.5: many a1-rare-S2 D1 steps are silent, and no observed variable tested (reward, good state, value, choice) separates them cleanly. Only observed variables are used.
